profile_sync_desc: Manage your vault identity and cloud connection.
security_desc: Manage local encryption and data storage.
lock_vault_desc: Clear keys from memory and return to the lock screen.
wipe_data_desc: Permanently delete local database and disconnect.
vault_location_desc: Switch to an existing vault or start a new one in another folder. The current vault stays untouched unless you choose Move current vault.
vault_location_restart: The app will restart. An existing vault in the selected folder will open; an empty folder will be used for a new vault.
host_transfer_desc: Transfer SSH hosts and their group assignments. Passwords, private keys, and saved-credential links are not included.
host_transfer_import_result: Imported {{hosts}} hosts and {{groups}} groups. Skipped {{skipped}} unsupported entries.
host_transfer_secrets_note: MobaXterm CSV exports can be imported using MobaXterm’s “Import sessions from third-party programs” command.
show_host_groups_desc: Show or hide group labels and filters on the Hosts page.
switch_warning: You are currently connected to {{url}}. Switching will upload your local encrypted data to the new server.
connect_info: Register your local account on the server to enable E2E encrypted cloud sync.
wipe_confirm_desc: This will permanently delete your local database, encryption keys, and log you out. This action cannot be undone.
